## Data source

This site uses Driveline Baseball Research & Development's
[OpenBiomechanics pitching data](https://github.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics),
including its [full-signal release](https://github.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/releases/tag/dataset-v1)
and [pitch-level summary file](https://github.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/blob/main/baseball_pitching/data/poi/poi_metrics.csv).
The data are used under the project's
[CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data license](https://github.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/blob/main/LICENSE-DATA.md).
